function.name: search_book_pages
function.description: Find topic words or a passage on actual pages of a local indexed PDF. Search_documents first to choose the book; never guess paths. All query words must occur on a page (accent/case insensitive); use concise content keywords. Returns excerpts, 1-based PDF page numbers and PDF page labels. Labels may differ from printed numbers. Searches up to max_pages per call; continue at next_start_page for remaining pages. Textless/scanned pages require OCR and are reported separately.

file_path.description: Exact indexed PDF path returned by search_documents.

function.name: read_book_page
function.description: Read one exact 1-based PDF page from an indexed book, with citation metadata. Use a page returned by search_book_pages or explicitly requested by the user. Report truncation/textless pages honestly. To save a quotation, bind record_work_note to the actual result field.

file_path.description: Exact indexed PDF path returned by search_documents.

function.name: deliver_document
function.description: Give the user an original indexed file as an openable local conversation attachment. Use this when the user asks for the file itself, including a file found earlier. Requires the exact observed indexed path; search_documents first if unknown. Creates an attachment reference with the file's actual metadata and hash; does not open, copy or upload it.

function.name: search_documents
function.description: Search local indexed documents (slides, lecture notes, syllabus, lab guides) by filename, subject or content keywords. Try another query when results are irrelevant. Returns file metadata only. Use read_document or read_book_page to read contents.

query.description: Search query containing course title or topic.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5).

function.name: read_document
function.description: Read content of an indexed document (.pdf, .pptx, .docx, .txt, .md). Requires an exact path returned by search_documents or previous source metadata. Never guess paths. If the path is unknown, search_documents first.

file_path.description: Exact indexed path from a search result or previous source metadata.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text content to read (default 3000).

function.name: inspect_artifact
function.description: Read actual data of an existing result by its observed artifact_id and optional revision. Use before discussing an earlier result whose contents are not in current observations.

function.name: request_operation_tools
function.description: Reveal registered operation input schemas for your next decision when a needed tool is missing. This only discovers tools; it does not read, deliver, save or perform their work. Choose exact names from operation_names, then call the revealed tool normally.
